scope_entries.finding: set_memory stops and restarts the whole guard on any MemoryRule inequality and carries only killer.export_state() (daemon.py:767-781); Trigger keeps its 10 s slope window in a deque on the instance (memtrigger.py:60-72) and needs MIN_SAMPLES = 3, so every boundary save from the page resets runaway detection on that box

scope_entries.surface: challenge pass / security + reversibility lens: preview-to-save gap
scope_entries.finding: the design's kill warning is a page dialog fed by a preview taken seconds earlier; a SIGKILL cannot be undone and the guard acts within reload 2 s + scan up to 10 s (daemon.py:106; memguard.py:300-310); nothing in the spec made the confirmation binding for the CLI path or for a process that appears after the preview

scope_entries.surface: challenge pass / security lens: what a boundary write can do (docs/contracts/memory.md Boundaries)
scope_entries.finding: within its boundary a process is never blamed or killed (issue #18 background; memboundary applied_rule, memboundary.py:63-69), so the write path can disable the guard as well as trigger kills; _validate_allow_fields requires only one non-empty matcher (config.py:600-607)

scope_entries.surface: challenge pass / security lens: heat_governor/mesh_server.py + the EliteMini unit
scope_entries.finding: the server has no auth, Origin or Host handling and its CSP allows inline script (mesh_server.py:47-50); the live unit binds 100.95.106.3:9480 over plain HTTP (systemctl --user cat heat-governor-mesh.service); the spec guarded writes but left the preview, which returns command lines of another box, unclassified

scope_entries.surface: challenge pass / failure-mode lens: half-completed write over SSH
scope_entries.finding: the reader's timeout_s is 5 s in the live fleet.toml and SshTransport kills the child on expiry (transport.py _collect); a write can therefore succeed on the box while the reader reports a failure

scope_entries.surface: challenge pass / rollback + observability lens: backups and the change event
scope_entries.finding: the spec said 'atomic + backup' without a count or a restore path, and the boxes already accumulate unbounded config.toml.bak-* files (live probe); the change event was tied to a reload (c9), and maybe_reload only compares against the config the running process loaded (daemon.py:502-540), so a restart between change and reload emits nothing

scope_entries.surface: challenge pass / operations + overlooked-actors lens: CLAUDE.md working rules and the CLI path
scope_entries.finding: CLAUDE.md requires the user's go-ahead for run --apply, [memory] action = kill and [ship] and keeps tests off real /sys and /proc, but has no rule for a remote config write; the spec's token model covered the page only, while c6 gives the same write to a CLI that talks SSH directly

scope_entries.surface: challenge pass / reversibility lens: PR 1 (read side)
scope_entries.finding: clean: PR 1 only adds keys to /state (docs/contracts/state.md says clients ignore unknown fields) and to /api/fleet, adds no write path, and the history ring is untouched (fleet_reader.py:442-482); reverting it removes the tab and nothing else

scope_entries.surface: challenge pass / unexamined surfaces
